segments.description: Footage of a cyclist riding on a road to introduce bicycle gears.
Animated graphics illustrating the components of a bike's gear system including chainrings and cassette.
Animated paper background explaining gear ratios with mathematical formulas and bike diagrams.
B-roll of a cyclist riding downhill and around curves on a road.
Animated graphic explaining cadence and rotation rates per minute.
Historical footage of professional cyclist Lance Armstrong during a race.
Graphic overlay on Lance Armstrong image discussing gear teeth and cassette setup.
Clip of a cyclist climbing a mountain road in a competition.
Graphic showing the cassette cog size on crumpled paper background.
Aerial view of cyclists riding along a winding mountain road bend.
Animated graphic showing gradient scale and thumbs down reaction.
End screen showing social media links and subscribe button.

hook.opening_visual: Close-up shot of a person cycling, focusing on pedals and chain motion.
hook.opening_line: Gears are a fundamental part of a bicycle.
hook.notes: Introduces the purpose and mechanism of bike gears using action footage.
